note: Loki will machine a 76 mm nozzle exit out to 2.0 inches on request, and nothing in the app said so. Every 76 mm Loki motor now carries a line under the Nozzle exit diameter field: what Loki's standard exit is, that it can be machined out, and how much more area 2.0 inches is for that motor - 21 % on the 1.818 in band, 78 % on the 1.500 in one. Said there and nowhere else, because a 38 or 54 mm flyer cannot buy the option. The four Loki motors still without a published exit also say why individually now: N3800-LW and N5500LW stay unknown until the figures turn up; L2050LW and M1378LR use one-time-use nozzles the owner has in hand and will measure.
